invariants: Conversation memory survives CLI process restarts when the same SQLite database is reused.
Only successful governed ACT outcomes carrying an external evidence_ref may update learned lessons.
Failed or unverified outcomes are retained as experience but cannot create reusable lessons.
A reusable skill candidate requires repeated evidenced success for the same learned pattern.
BRO cannot activate a candidate automatically: promotion requires a prior explicit approval actor and a separate explicit promotion actor.
Learning-hook failure cannot reverse or falsify an already completed governed action receipt.
Relevant learned lessons may inform later conversation and specialist selection but never grant authority or bypass ACT confirmation.

truth_boundary.repository_claim: Durable storage, retrieval, outcome accumulation, candidate creation, and guarded approval/promotion transitions are implemented and testable.
